answer.why: Last.fm refused deadwax's API key (error 10: Invalid API key - You must be granted a valid key by last.fm) - check LASTFM_API_KEY in Server settings > Connections: it's the API key, not the shared secret.

cases.name: no key: off, and where to add one

answer.why: No Last.fm API key is set - add LASTFM_API_KEY in Server settings > Connections (a free key from last.fm/api/account/create).
